correctness.rationale: For any L>=3, parity-preserving interior swaps and twisted seam 00<->11 have symmetric generator and uniform stationary parity sectors. Within either sector, E sigma_i=0 and E sigma_i sigma_j=delta_ij. Exact generator action on individual spins closes on the antiperiodic discrete Laplacian Delta_a (sigma_0=-sigma_L,sigma_{L+1}=-sigma_1), giving C_ij(t)=(e^{t Delta_a})_ij and the (2k+1)-Fourier formula. Its antiperiodic lattice heat kernel K_d satisfies K_(L-d)=-K_d; restricted to 0<=d<L/2 the reflected half-line finite Metzler system is irreducible, hence K_d(t)>0 at every positive time; antipodal d=L/2 is zero if L even. Direct finite differences show (-Delta_a)^-1_ij=L/4-|i-j|/2. Summing all entries yields integrated M covariance L(L^2+2)/12 and normalized tau_M=(L^2+2)/12. Independent numerical matrix exponentials/inverse Green functions for all 3<=L<=12 matched exact sign and integrated kernels; finite check is not infinite proof.
